description.text: Foreword I am delighted that these beautiful stories are being gathered together into one volume so that Ethiopian children can enjoy them and learn from their wisdom. I collected them in five extraordinary journeys, traveling all through Ethiopia, from north to south and east to west, meeting many wonderful storytellers, both men and women, who shared their rich treasure of stories with me.
